idea: MpcFirewall eliminates the 32-byte blind-signing vulnerability in NEAR Chain Signatures (v1.signer). Existing NEAR Function Call Keys only inspect NEAR-native calls and are blind when an AI agent passes an opaque 32-byte keccak256 digest to v1.signer for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, or Bitcoin transactions—allowing ERC20.approve(drainer, MaxUint256) or nested multicall drains to slip through. MpcFirewall moves the MPC derivation path inside a Rust NEAR smart contract (contracts/mpc-firewall): agents submit raw unsigned EVM RLP or Bitcoin bytes, the contract decodes calldata recursively on-chain (blocking unlimited approvals, setApprovalForAll, wrong chainIds, and smuggled multicall drains), computes keccak256/sha256d on-chain, enforces autonomous daily caps, escalates oversized txs to Trezu/SputnikDAO proposals, and performs confidential intent-vs-calldata verification via NEAR AI Cloud TEE.
